name: aurora-academico
description: Aurora 2.4 RC interna — auditoria de segurança, triagem consentida e otimizações condicionais

scripts.deploy: node scripts/predeploy-check.mjs && npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run bench
scripts.lint: node --check src/web/client.js && node --check src/web/sw.js && node --check src/web/install.js && node --check scripts/setup-wizard.mjs && node --check scripts/backup-local.mjs && node --check scripts/restore-local.mjs && node --check scripts/backup-cloud.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-cloud-restore.mjs && node --check scripts/restore-cloud-to-new.mjs && node --check scripts/d1-backup-crypto.mjs && node --check scripts/create-vapid-keys.mjs
scripts.release:gate: npm run verify && node scripts/doctor.mjs --strict && node scripts/predeploy-check.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run smoke:http && npm run bench && npm run bench:d1 && npm run bench:multi && npm run audit:pwa && npm run security:check && npm run doctor
